To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dormancy cycle is regulated by a complex network involving light, hormones, MADS-box transcription factor, phytochrome, phytochrome-interacting transcription factors, auxin, auxin response factors and epigenetic regulation.

(1) PIFs and PIF-like transcription factors play important roles in growth and dormancy regulation in perennial trees, and (2) epigenetic modifications may be important for seasonal growth regulation in perennial plants.

the timing of the onset of dormancy and the release of dormancy in perennial plants are regulated by at least three programs that involve phytochromes and phytochrome-interacting transcription factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of genes and regulatory networks controlling growth and dormancy transitions in woody perennials.
the molecular mechanisms that control the annual growth-dormancy cycles of perennial woody plants.
the molecular mechanisms of the growth-dormant cycle, with the aim of identifying the genes that regulate the transition between growth and dormancy in perennial horticulture and forestry plants.

the regulation of the dormancy cycle in perennial horticulture and forestry species is complex and involves a large number of genes.

dormancy is a complex trait, regulated by multiple genes, and that a better understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying this trait will contribute to better manipulation of horticultural traits.

the molecular mechanisms controlling the growth-dormant cycle in perennial horticulture and forestry are still poorly understood, although the molecular basis of dormancy regulation has been investigated in many plant species.

the dormancy/growing process is regulated by multiple factors and pathways.
dormancy is an integrated process regulated by a combination of environmental, genetic, and hormonal cues.

a molecular framework for seasonal dormancy regulation has emerged.
